figures.title: Axis reflection mappings
figures.description: Depict the foundation problem exactly: Classify x^4-3x^2+1. Show the quantities, axes, intervals, or algebraic objects needed to reach this conclusion: Even.
figures.anchorInterpretation: Substituting -x leaves the formula unchanged.
figures.mechanism: Negate output coordinates or input coordinates, then test f(-x)=f(x) for even symmetry and f(-x)=-f(x) for odd symmetry.
figures.validStructure: Symmetry claims require a domain symmetric about zero.
figures.invalidMove: A frequent error is confusing -f(x) with f(-x).
figures.lessonOutcome: Reflect function graphs across coordinate axes and connect reflection rules with even and odd symmetry.
